svg.text: One knob, two effects: 4 threads x 1,000,000 adds on the 4-CPU Linux VM (the guide's padded counter)
one lock alone: 0.0944 s (S = 1 is slower than that)
Speed: fewer trips to the shared lock
Every add takes its own local lock, which nobody
else wants. Only one add in S also takes the global
lock: about 4,000,000 / S trips (one per full batch).
The time falls fast, then flattens after S = 32.
Each local count can hold up to S adds the global
count has not received yet. 4 local counts: get()
can be up to 4 x S behind the truth. That keeps
growing while the time hardly moves.
